name: Select
description: A dropdown menu for displaying choices.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Show clear button
props.descriptionZh: 支持清除

props.name: autoClearSearchValue
props.description: Whether the current search will be cleared on selecting an item. Only applies when `mode` is set to `multiple` or `tags`
props.descriptionZh: 是否在选中项后清空搜索框，只在 `mode` 为 `multiple` 或 `tags` 时有效

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数

props.name: defaultActiveFirstOption
props.description: Whether active first option by default
props.descriptionZh: 是否默认高亮第一个选项

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether disabled select
props.descriptionZh: 是否禁用

props.name: dropdownClassName
props.description: The className of dropdown menu, **Deprecated. Use `classes.popup.root` instead**
props.descriptionZh: 下拉菜单的 className 属性，**已废弃，请使用 `classes.popup.root` 替换**

props.name: dropdownMatchSelectWidth
props.description: Determine whether the dropdown menu and the select input are the same width, **Deprecated. Use `popupMatchSelectWidth` instead**
props.descriptionZh: 下拉菜单和选择器同宽，**已废弃，请使用 `popupMatchSelectWidth` 替换**

props.name: dropdownRender
props.description: Customize dropdown content, **Deprecated. Use `popupRender` instead**
props.descriptionZh: 自定义下拉框内容，**已废弃，请使用 `popupRender` 替换**

props.name: dropdownStyle
props.description: The style of dropdown menu, **Deprecated. Use `styles.popup.root` instead**
props.descriptionZh: 下拉菜单的 style 属性，**已废弃，请使用 `styles.popup.root` 替换**

props.name: fieldNames
props.description: Customize node label, value, options, groupLabel field name
props.descriptionZh: 自定义节点 label、value、options、groupLabel 的字段

props.name: filterOption
props.description: If true, filter options by input, if function, filter options against it. The function will receive two arguments, `inputValue` and `option`, if the function returns true, the option will be included in the filtered set; Otherwise, it will be excluded
props.descriptionZh: 是否根据输入项进行筛选。当其为一个函数时，会接收 `inputValue` `option` 两个参数，当 `option` 符合筛选条件时，应返回 true，反之则返回 false

props.name: filterSort
props.type: (optionA: Option, optionB: Option, info: { searchValue: string }) => number
props.description: Sort function for search options sorting, see Array.sort's compareFunction
props.descriptionZh: 搜索时对筛选结果项的排序函数, 类似[Array.sort](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/sort)里的 compareFunction

props.name: getPopupContainer
props.description: Parent Node which the selector should be rendered to. Default to body. When position issues happen, try to modify it into scrollable content and position it relative
props.descriptionZh: 菜单渲染父节点。默认渲染到 body 上，如果你遇到菜单滚动定位问题，试试修改为滚动的区域，并相对其定位

props.name: labelInValue
props.description: Whether to embed label in value, turn the format of value from `string` to `{ value: string, label: VueNode }`
props.descriptionZh: 是否把每个选项的 label 包装到 value 中，会把 Select 的 value 类型从 `string` 变为 `{ value: string, label: VueNode }` 的格式

props.name: listHeight
props.description: Config popup height
props.descriptionZh: 设置弹窗滚动高度

props.name: loading
props.description: Indicate loading state
props.descriptionZh: 加载中状态

props.name: maxCount
props.description: The max number of items can be selected, only applies when `mode` is `multiple` or `tags`
props.descriptionZh: 最多可选择的项目数，仅在 `mode` 为 `multiple` 或 `tags` 时生效

props.name: maxTagCount
props.description: Max tag count to show. `responsive` will cost render performance
props.descriptionZh: 最多显示多少个 tag，`responsive` 会根据宽度自适应

props.name: maxTagPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for not showing tags
props.descriptionZh: 隐藏 tag 时显示的内容

props.name: maxTagTextLength
props.description: Max tag text length to show
props.descriptionZh: 最大显示的 tag 文本长度

props.name: menuItemSelectedIcon
props.description: The custom menuItemSelected icon with multiple options
props.descriptionZh: 自定义多选时当前选中的条目图标

props.name: mode
props.description: Set mode of Select
props.descriptionZh: 设置 Select 的模式为多选或标签

props.name: notFoundContent
props.description: Specify content to show when no result matches
props.descriptionZh: 当下拉列表为空时显示的内容

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of dropdown
props.descriptionZh: 是否展开下拉菜单

props.name: optionFilterProp
props.description: Which prop value of option will be used for filter if filterOption is true. If options is set, it should be set to label. When a string[] is provided, multiple fields are searched using OR matching
props.descriptionZh: 搜索时过滤对应的 `option` 属性，如设置为 `children` 表示对内置 `option` 的 `children` 进行搜索。若通过 `options` 属性配置选项内容，建议设置 `optionFilterProp="label"` 来对内容进行搜索。当为字符串数组时，会使用 OR 匹配多个字段

props.name: options
props.description: Select options. Will get better perf than jsx definition
props.descriptionZh: 数据化配置选项内容，相比 jsx 定义会获得更好的渲染性能

props.name: optionRender
props.description: Customize the rendering dropdown options
props.descriptionZh: 自定义渲染下拉选项

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder of select
props.descriptionZh: 选择框默认文本

props.name: placement
props.description: The position where the selection box pops up
props.descriptionZh: 选择框弹出的位置

props.name: popupClassName
props.description: The className of dropdown menu, use `classes.popup.root` instead
props.descriptionZh: 下拉菜单的 className 属性，使用 `classes.popup.root` 替换

props.name: popupMatchSelectWidth
props.description: Determine whether the dropdown menu and the select input are the same width. Default set `min-width` same as input. Will ignore when value less than select width. `false` will disable virtual scroll
props.descriptionZh: 下拉菜单和选择器同宽。默认将设置 `min-width`，当值小于选择框宽度时会被忽略。`false` 时会关闭虚拟滚动

props.name: popupRender
props.description: Customize dropdown content
props.descriptionZh: 自定义下拉框内容

props.name: prefix
props.description: The custom prefix
props.descriptionZh: 自定义前缀

props.name: removeIcon
props.description: The custom remove icon
props.descriptionZh: 自定义的多选框清除图标

props.name: searchValue
props.description: The current input "search" text
props.descriptionZh: 控制搜索文本

props.name: showSearch
props.description: Whether select is searchable
props.descriptionZh: 配置是否可搜索

props.name: size
props.description: Size of Select input
props.descriptionZh: 选择框大小

props.name: status
props.description: Set validation status
props.descriptionZh: 设置校验状态

props.name: styles
props.description: Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数

props.name: suffixIcon
props.description: The custom suffix icon. Customize icon will not response click open to avoid icon designed to do other interactive. You can use `pointer-events: none` style to bypass
props.descriptionZh: 自定义的选择框后缀图标。以防止图标被用于其他交互，替换的图标默认不会响应展开、收缩事件，可以通过添加 `pointer-events: none` 样式透传

props.name: tagRender
props.description: Customize tag render, only applies when `mode` is set to `multiple` or `tags`
props.descriptionZh: 自定义 tag 内容 render，仅在 `mode` 为 `multiple` 或 `tags` 时生效

props.name: labelRender
props.description: Customize selected label render
props.descriptionZh: 自定义当前选中的 label 内容 render

props.name: tokenSeparators
props.description: Separator used to tokenize, only applies when `mode="tags"`
props.descriptionZh: 自动分词的分隔符，仅在 `mode="tags"` 时生效

props.name: value
props.description: Current selected option (considered as a immutable array), support `v-model:value`
props.descriptionZh: 指定当前选中的条目，多选时为数组，支持 `v-model:value`

props.name: variant
props.description: Variants of selector
props.descriptionZh: 形态变体

props.name: virtual
props.description: Disable virtual scroll when set to false
props.descriptionZh: 设置 false 时关闭虚拟滚动

events.name: active
events.description: Called when keyboard or mouse interaction occurs
events.descriptionZh: 键盘和鼠标交互时触发

events.name: change
events.description: Called when select an option or input value change
events.descriptionZh: 选中 option，或 input 的 value 变化时，调用此函数

events.name: deselect
events.description: Called when an option is deselected, param is the selected option's value. Only called for `multiple` or `tags`, effective in multiple or tags mode only
events.descriptionZh: 取消选中时调用，参数为选中项的 value (或 key) 值，仅在 `multiple` 或 `tags` 模式下生效

events.name: dropdownVisibleChange
events.description: Called when dropdown open, **Deprecated. Use `openChange` instead**
events.descriptionZh: 展开下拉菜单的回调，**已废弃，请使用 `openChange` 替换**

events.name: openChange
events.descriptionZh: 下拉框展开或收起时回调

events.name: popupScroll
events.descriptionZh: 下拉列表滚动时的回调

events.name: search
events.description: Callback function that is fired when input changed

events.name: select
events.description: Called when an option is selected, the params are option's value (or key) and option instance
events.descriptionZh: 被选中时调用，参数为选中项的 value (或 key) 值

slots.name: labelRender
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义当前选中的 label 内容 render

slots.name: maxTagPlaceholder
slots.descriptionZh: 隐藏 tag 时显示的内容

slots.name: menuItemSelectedIcon
slots.description: The custom menuItemSelected icon with multiple options
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义多选时当前选中的条目图标

slots.name: notFoundContent
slots.description: Specify content to show when no result matches
slots.descriptionZh: 当下拉列表为空时显示的内容

slots.name: removeIcon
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义的多选框清除图标

slots.name: suffixIcon
slots.description: The custom suffix icon. Customize icon will not response click open to avoid icon designed to do other interactive. You can use `pointer-events: none` style to bypass
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义的选择框后缀图标。以防止图标被用于其他交互，替换的图标默认不会响应展开、收缩事件，可以通过添加 `pointer-events: none` 样式透传

slots.name: tagRender
slots.description: Customize tag render, only applies when `mode` is set to `multiple` or `tags`
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义 tag 内容 render，仅在 `mode` 为 `multiple` 或 `tags` 时生效

properties.name: onSearch

properties.name: title
properties.descriptionZh: 选中该 Option 后，Select 的 title

commonProps.name: rootClass
commonProps.descriptionZh: 添加在组件最外层的 className

commonProps.name: autoFocus
commonProps.description: Auto focus when component mounted, only effective for focusable elements like forms, links, etc.
commonProps.descriptionZh: 自动获取焦点，仅对表单类、链接、交互容器等可聚焦元素生效
